blockingFindings.title: Spec target guard is only exercised on status
blockingFindings.issue: R2 requires explicit spec targets to be checked against the current dispatcher execution context, but the spec mismatch coverage only calls `get status --expect-spec`. No test exercises a dispatcher command such as `get next-action` or `run ...` with a mismatched `--expect-spec`, so an implementation could guard status while still executing the active flow for spec-targeted dispatcher commands.
blockingFindings.requiredChange: Add the smallest regression case that runs at least one dispatcher command with a mismatched `--expect-spec` and asserts `ACTIVE_FLOW_MISMATCH` plus no active-flow mutation.
blockingFindings.whyBlocking: This leaves an acceptance requirement without spec-local executable coverage for the dispatcher behavior it requires.

blockingFindings.title: RunId target guard is only partially exercised for dispatcher context
blockingFindings.issue: R2 requires explicit runId targets to be checked against the current dispatcher execution context. The tests cover `get status --expect-run-id` and one `get next-action --expect-run-id` case tied to positional display behavior, but they do not cover any `run` dispatcher command with a mismatched explicit runId.
blockingFindings.requiredChange: Add one mismatched `--expect-run-id` test on a mutating `run` dispatcher command and assert `ACTIVE_FLOW_MISMATCH` and unchanged active-flow state.
blockingFindings.whyBlocking: A run-command path could still authorize execution from a mismatched runId while the current tests pass.
